title: Derived equivalences via Tate resolutions
summary: For any finite sequence of elements $s_1, \ldots , s_d$ in a commutative noetherian ring $R$, we show that for $n \gg 0$, the natural map from the Koszul complex $K(s_1^n, \ldots , s_d^n)$ to the Koszul complex $K(s_1, \ldots , s_d)$ factors through the Tate resolution on $s_1^n, \ldots , s_d^n$.
